summary:
Main
On the first day of the National Day holiday every domestic price basis went dark at once - the DCE is shut and neither yuanspot nor the three port spot indices were quoted. Those fields in this report carry their last Sep 30 values and are marked accordingly. The only market actually trading was the seaborne one, and its signal is clear enough: the MMi 61% seaborne index fell to USD 93.00/dmt (-1.27%) and the 65% to 111.75 (-0.22%), with only IOCJ holding at 112.00 among the 12 mainstream seaborne fines; everything else lost USD 1.05-1.60.
